Description: STM32C0 series MCU, Arm Cortex-M0+, 128KB flash, 32-pin LQFP
Notes: Core of the circuit. Pin-compatible alternate: STM32C071KBT6 (-40/+105C temp grade instead of -40/+85C) at https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/stmicroelectronics/STM32C071KBT6/24770022
Lets the QFP-packaged MCU plug into a breadboard. Sold by Adafruit in packs of 3; confirm current DigiKey packaging/quantity before ordering.
